purpose: Teach: 風速/乗船/高熱/鼓動/洗顔/授乳/浄水/脊髄

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、台風時の風速観測史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote your paper on typhoon wind speed observations, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Warm, steady interest. Gentle confirmation in the rise. The tone of a teacher who's read the work and is inviting the student to talk about it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、近世の乗船記録を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I focused on early modern ship logs as primary sources.
lines.style: Direct and clear. A slight lift of confidence—she knows this material. Not rehearsed, but prepared. Eye contact steady.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 高熱性疾患の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And before that, you explored the history of high-fever illnesses, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle, connecting-the-dots tone. The inflection of someone drawing out a pattern across a student's work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、胎児の心臓鼓動研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I researched fetal cardiac rhythms and historical documentation of them.
lines.style: Composed, precise. Each phrase lands with quiet assurance. No hesitation—she's secure in the material. Slight formality befitting academic discussion.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: スキンケアの洗顔法を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And then there was your skincare and cleansing methodology paper.
lines.style: Slight lift in tone—almost gentle amusement at the range of her interests. Still warm, still engaged. Not questioning the choice, just noticing it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、新生児の授乳パターンを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I examined newborn feeding patterns and how they've been documented over time.
lines.style: Steady and professional. A touch more emphasis on 'examined'—she's defending the rigor of this work. Clear and unrushed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 災害時の浄水器配備を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you also covered water purification systems in disaster response contexts.
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. Low, even pace. The tone of someone seeing a larger picture emerge. Not judging—appreciating the scope.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、脊髄損傷リハビリを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I looked into spinal cord rehabilitation protocols and their practical applications.
lines.style: Final statement with quiet closure. Poised and complete. Slightly slower pace—she's reached the end of this survey and rested there. Confident without defensiveness.
